extension_description.message: Bilingual pages and dual subtitles. Sentences you truly read become spaced-repetition cards. Bring your own key.

yt_subtitle_not_ready.message: Subtitles not ready yet — try again after the translation loads

options_custom_api_hint.message: Leave blank to use this engine's default endpoint. If you fill it in, enter the complete request URL including its path — we send it exactly as typed and never append anything. Works for proxies and self-hosted services.

options_color_preview.message: This is a preview of the translation style

options_cache_hint.message: Translations are cached for 12 hours to reduce API requests.

options_about_desc.message: Bilingual translation + a learning loop: sentences you actually read become review cards.

options_about_safari.message: Safari iOS: enable it in Settings → Safari → Extensions.

toast_endpoint_cleared.message: Engine changed — the endpoint URL was cleared

hint_glm.message: GLM (Zhipu AI) API Key (free tier available).

hint_qwen_mt.message: Qwen MT (DashScope) API Key. A translation-specialised model — cheaper and faster than a general chat model. Same key as Qwen.

hint_kimi.message: Kimi (Moonshot) API Key from the matching region platform.

hint_custom_chat.message: Any Chat-Completions-format chat endpoint. Enter the complete endpoint URL, model and key. If the address ends in responses, the Responses format is sent instead.

hint_custom_msg.message: Any Messages-format chat endpoint. Enter the complete endpoint URL, model and key.

options_custom_model_hint.message: Leave blank to use the engine's default model.

options_adv_max_tokens_hint.message: Blank uses 2000. Raise it if long paragraphs get cut off.

options_adv_timeout_hint.message: Blank uses 20s. Raise it for slow self-hosted or reasoning models.

options_adv_concurrency_hint.message: Blank uses 5. Lower it if you are being rate-limited; raising it will not speed up requests already waiting.

options_adv_unsupported.message: This model does not accept this parameter, so it will not be sent.

options_adv_custom_hint.message: A JSON object, merged into the request body and overriding the fields above. For self-hosted or internal endpoints we have not measured.

options_adv_custom_bad.message: Could not parse, so nothing will be sent:

options_adv_custom_notobj.message: Must be a JSON object; nothing will be sent.

err_reasoning_starved.message: The model spent its entire output budget on reasoning and produced no translation. Raise "Max output per request" under Advanced parameters, or switch to a non-reasoning model.

setup_need_key.message: This engine needs an API key. Translation will not work until you enter one below.

setup_free_channel.message: You are on the free no-key engine — fine for a first look. It is not a stable endpoint: it sometimes returns your original text unchanged. Switching to any LLM engine with your own key is noticeably more reliable, and better.

learn_empty_body.message: Turn on capture, then just browse and translate as usual. Sentences you actually read get saved — the ones you scroll straight past do not.

learn_alldone_body.message: Keep browsing and translating — new material arrives on its own.

learn_section_hint.message: When on, sentences you actually read are kept ON THIS DEVICE together with the page address, its title and how long the text was on screen, and resurfaced on a forgetting curve. Skimming past does not count. Nothing is uploaded unless you turn on sync, and one button erases all of it.

learn_clear_confirm.message: Erase the learning corpus? Every collected sentence and all review progress will be deleted, and this cannot be undone.

toast_learn_off.message: Collection stopped (what was already collected is kept)

learn_replay_hint.message: Opens the source in a new tab at that timestamp — bilingual subtitles work there too.

tts_section_hint.message: Turn review cards into listening practice. Uses your device's own voice by default — no network, no cost. You can also point it at a speech server you run yourself.

tts_mode_assist.message: Show the text, with a play button

tts_mode_audio_first.message: Listen first (text hidden until you ask)

tts_hint_browser.message: Uses the voices your operating system already has. Nothing is sent anywhere and nothing is cached — this engine only speaks, it cannot hand back audio.

tts_hint_local.message: A speech server on your own machine or LAN — enter the complete address, following the example shown in the field. Synthesis is cached locally, so a sentence costs you only once.

tts_hint_openai.message: Uses your own API key. Synthesized audio is cached locally so a card is only paid for once.

tts_voice_hint.message: Voices are matched to each card's language. The one you pick here is only used when it actually speaks that language.

tts_autoplay.message: Play automatically when a card opens

tts_test_sample.message: This is what your review cards will sound like.

tts_no_voice.message: Your system has no voice for this language

tts_unsupported.message: This browser offers no built-in speech

tts_blocked.message: The browser blocked autoplay — tap to play

tts_http.message: The speech service returned an error

tts_failed.message: This sentence cannot be spoken right now

tts_cache.message: Speech cache: {n} clips · about {mb} MB (limit {cap} MB)

tts_cache_na.message: The built-in device voice produces no cache

learn_pressure_dropped.message: {n} captured items could not be saved — this happens when the corpus is full.

learn_pressure_evicted.message: The corpus is full — {n} old cards were dropped automatically to make room.

toast_import_bad_format.message: That is not a learning-corpus export file

sync_section_hint.message: Optional. Everything works without signing in — once signed in, your library (including candidates) and review history sync both ways across your devices.

sync_err_offline.message: Can't reach the server; this will retry later. Everything you have learned is on this device.

sync_err_quota.message: Your cloud storage is full, so new material is not being uploaded (this device is unaffected). Clearing mastered cards frees space.

sync_err_signed_out.message: Your session expired. Please sign in again.

sync_err_rate.message: Too many codes requested. Try again in a few minutes.

sync_code_sent.message: Code sent to {email}. Enter it below.

sync_signed_in_now.message: Signed in. The first sync may take a few seconds.

sync_bad_code.message: That code is wrong or expired. Request a new one.

sync_status_offline.message: Currently offline — will retry automatically. Your learning data is saved on this device.

sync_status_signed_out.message: Not signed in — local data only

sync_signed_out.message: Signed out. Your learning library stays on this device, untouched.

sync_delete_confirm.message: Delete cloud data and account? Everything on the server and this account will be deleted permanently. Your library on this device is kept.

sync_deleted.message: Cloud data and account deleted. Your library on this device is kept.

sync_deleted_partial.message: Cloud data deleted, but the account could not be removed ({why}). You can retry or contact us.

sync_err_upgrade.message: There is something in the cloud this version can't read yet (probably written by a newer build). Update the extension, then sync — nothing is lost, it just can't be read yet.

toast_import_upgrade.message: This file was written by a newer version of the extension. Update, then import it. There is nothing wrong with the file.

options_init_failed.message: The settings page failed to load ({err}). Reopen this page; if it keeps happening, please report this message to us.

settings_read_failed.message: Your saved settings could not be read, so the defaults are shown below. Do not save from this page — it would overwrite what you had. ({why})

learn_relearn.description: Grade-0 consequence label on the review card

learn_days_unit.description: Unit word for days in the strength label

learn_howto_1.message: Remember it → the interval grows, the card returns later.

learn_howto_2.message: Forget it → it starts over and returns soon.

learn_howto_3.message: When strength reaches 180 days, the card graduates.

learn_cap_hint.message: Up to {n} new cards a day — adjustable in Settings.
learn_cap_hint.description: Deck-done hint naming the daily new-card cap; {n} is the cap

learn_practice_rule.message: Practice cannot grind out mastery, but it can expose forgetting.
learn_practice_rule.description: One-line rule: practice fails count, passes do not lengthen intervals

learn_pool_learning.description: Practice pool option: learning cards only

learn_mastered_full.description: Badge when strength is full and all available skills passed

learn_shadow_hint.description: Shadowing invitation at the listen tier; explicitly practice, never graded

learn_write_replaced.description: Note shown when wrong blanks were replaced with correct answers

learn_notes_cost.message: Uses your configured API — one call, cached forever
learn_notes_cost.description: Cost line under the notes button; doubles as its status line

learn_notes_failed_empty.message: The model returned no answer text — thinking/reasoner models don't suit sentence notes; pick a chat model in settings.

app_lede.message: Sentences you read in the browser sync here for review.

app_local_note.message: The browser extension captures and reviews without an account — everything stays on your device. Signing in only syncs your material to this device.

app_sync_empty.message: Synced, but the server has nothing yet — capture some sentences in the browser first, then sync again.

app_code_bad.message: Wrong or expired code — try again.

app_offline.message: Can't reach the server — check your connection and retry.

app_needs_upgrade.message: The server has content this version can't read — please update the app.

app_sync_disabled.message: Sync isn't enabled in this build. The browser extension's capture and review are unaffected — everything stays on your device.

app_set_tts_auto.message: Auto-speak when the translation is shown

app_set_tts_note.message: Cards with an unknown language (e.g. captured in Safari, which has no language detection) play only with the voice chosen above; without a choice they can't be spoken. The speech API key works like the sentence-notes key: it stays on this device only, never syncs with your account, and is stored in plaintext.

app_set_notes_note.message: Used only to generate sentence notes (words / phrases / grammar), calling your own API. The key stays on this device and never syncs with your account; it is separate from the key configured in the browser extension, with the same security standing — both are stored in plaintext on the device.

app_set_delete_note.message: Deleting permanently removes your material and review history from the server and closes the account. Content already downloaded to this device is unaffected — to remove that too, delete the app.

app_set_confirm_delete.message: Delete your account? Everything on the server will be permanently removed and cannot be recovered.

tts_no_voice_und.message: This card's language is unknown — pick a voice in settings and it will play

learn_langs_hint.message: Only sentences in the selected languages are captured. Where Safari cannot detect the language, the writing system decides; long-press saves are never filtered.

learn_block_hint.message: Wildcards supported: example.com matches the whole domain (subdomains too); *.example.com/news/* matches a path.

learn_delete_confirm.message: Delete {n} cards from {host}? This syncs to all your devices and cannot be undone.

learn_delete_none.message: Nothing left to delete from this source

sync_status_storage_error.message: Couldn't read the sign-in state (storage read failed); will retry shortly — this does not mean you were signed out.

learn_backup_failed.message: Local backup could not be written ({why}). The learning library itself is unaffected.

notes_engine_hint.message: The chat engine used by “Explain this sentence”. Follows the translation engine above by default; thinking/reasoner models don't suit notes.

learn_second_exercise.message: One more skill · does not affect the interval
learn_second_exercise.description: Note above grades during the appended second exercise (§5.4)

learn_listen_once.message: Listen first, then pick the words you heard

learn_check_pick.description: Confirm button for the word-pick exercise

learn_pack_loading.message: Generating this card's questions with your API (one call, cached forever)…

learn_pack_failed.message: Question generation failed — using the local exercise instead
learn_pack_failed.description: Pack failure line — local fallback used (§9.3)

stt_hint.message: Speaking-exercise recordings go to the endpoint configured here for transcription, then are discarded — never stored, never synced. No engine means no speaking exercise. The key stays on this device. A self-hosted server must allow cross-origin requests (CORS).

learn_speak_cost.message: Uses your configured transcription endpoint — one call per recording

stt_no_mic.message: This browser cannot access a microphone

stt_mic_denied.message: Microphone permission denied — using other exercises this session

stt_http.message: The transcription service returned an error

stt_unsupported.message: This browser does not support recording

stt_network.message: Cannot reach the transcription endpoint — check the URL, and note a self-hosted server must allow cross-origin requests (CORS)

engine_test_unknown_provider.message: This version doesn't recognise the saved engine — pick one above

engine_test_bad_output.message: The endpoint answered, but the content could not be parsed

engine_test_hint_key.message: the key is wrong or lacks permission

engine_test_hint_404.message: the endpoint URL (including its path) or the model name is wrong

engine_test_no_path.message: This address has only a host and no endpoint path — enter the complete request URL (see the example in the field)

engine_test_bad_url.message: The address does not start with http:// or https:// — without a scheme it is treated as a relative path and no request leaves at all

engine_test_timeout.message: The endpoint did not answer before the timeout

engine_test_route.description: Which transport path the self-check request actually used.

engine_test_route_proxy.message: the extension background (not subject to CORS, no preflight)
engine_test_route_proxy.description: Substituted into engine_test_route when the extension background sent it.

engine_test_route_direct.message: the page itself (sends an OPTIONS preflight first)
engine_test_route_direct.description: Substituted into engine_test_route when the page sent it.

engine_test_server_said.description: The server's own error sentence, shown verbatim under the engine self-check result.

engine_test_via_proxy.message: (Automatically retried from the extension background too, and that failed as well — so this is not a CORS problem; the address is genuinely unreachable from this machine.)
engine_test_via_proxy.description: Shown when the direct request was CORS-blocked and the background retry also failed.

notes_test_empty.message: The model returned no content — reasoning models do not fit here; switch to a chat model

learn_split_done.message: Split {p} long cards into {c} sentence cards

learn_split_skipped.message: ({k} kept whole — translation did not align)

app_pw_bad.message: Wrong email or password — try again.

drive_notes_engine_missing.message: Reading the notes aloud needs a notes engine first — set one up in Settings → Sentence notes

drive_notes_empty.message: This card has no notes to read

settings_read_failed_short.message: Cannot read your saved settings — try again in a moment

drive_play_notes_note.message: Each card is followed by its notes (words, phrases, one grammar point). On by default: a card that has never been analysed is analysed on the spot, using the engine you configured — charged once per card, cached from then on. Turn it off if you would rather not spend that; off, only the sentence and its translation are read.

drive_notes_cost.message: Reading notes: a card that has never been analysed calls your configured engine — charged once per card

drive_notes_failed.message: Could not analyse this card — skipped

drive_notes_no_base.message: The notes engine is not configured — skipped the notes for this card

drive_skip_card.message: This card cannot be read aloud — skipped to the next

drive_done.message: That's the end of this round

drive_skipped.message: Skipped {n} cards that cannot be read aloud (media cards or no voice)

drive_empty.message: No cards can be read aloud

drive_preload_hint.message: Tap this before you set off and the speech, notes and translations you are about to hear are downloaded to this device, so a whole session plays with no network. The first tap only prices it and spends nothing — check how many calls it will make before you tap again.

drive_preload_pricing.message: Checking what is already on this device…

drive_preload_no_audio_cache.message: The on-device voice produces no cache and already works offline, so only notes and translations are preloaded here.

drive_preload_no_fill_engine.message: No analysis engine configured, so cards without a translation cannot get one this time (Settings → Sentence notes)

drive_preload_ready.message: All of this is already on the device — you will not need a network on the road.

drive_preload_tts_bad.message: The speech engine is not configured ({reason}), so no audio can be synthesized this time (Settings → Speech engine)

drive_tts_not_configured.message: The speech engine is not configured, so nothing can be read aloud this round (Settings → Speech engine)

drive_tts_blocked.message: The system blocked autoplay — tap to continue

drive_tts_unsupported.message: No usable speech engine on this device

drive_tts_unreachable.message: Cannot reach the speech engine, so nothing can be read aloud this round. Only preloaded cards play offline (Settings → Preload for offline)

tts_timeout.message: The speech service timed out — check your network, or try another endpoint

tts_network.message: Cannot reach the speech service — check your network and the endpoint address

tts_empty.message: This card has no text to read aloud

drive_bg_session_failed.message: This device cannot start a background audio session right now, so playback pauses when the app leaves the screen.

drive_bg_needs_audio_engine.message: The built-in device voice stops once the app leaves the screen. To keep listening, configure a speech endpoint (Settings → Speech engine).

drive_awake_note.message: The screen won't auto-lock while podcast mode is in front. To keep seeing the card after you lock the phone, turn on the system's Always-On display: Settings → Display & Brightness → Always On.

app_empty_body.message: Learning material comes from the browser extension — this app is where you review it.

app_empty_how.message: Enable BelliedMonkey Translator in Settings → Safari → Extensions, turn on capture, then browse and translate as usual.

app_ext_off_body.message: Cards come from the Safari extension. It is not enabled, so this stays empty.

app_ext_unknown_title.message: Set up the browser half first

app_ext_ios_body.message: Cards come from the Safari extension: in Safari, tap the extensions icon at the left of the address bar → “Manage Extensions” → turn on BelliedMonkey Translator.

app_signin_why.message: Cards are captured by the browser extension. To review them on this device, sign in so they can sync over.

ob_welcome_body.message: Translation happens in the browser; review happens in this app. Two minutes to connect the two.

ob_ios_1.message: In Safari, tap the extensions icon at the left of the address bar

ob_ios_2.message: Choose “Manage Extensions” and turn on BelliedMonkey Translator

ob_ios_3.message: Set permissions to Allow, for All Websites

ob_browser_title.message: Two more things, in the browser

ob_browser_body.message: Both switches live in the extension's own settings — this app cannot change them; the two sides have separate storage.

ob_kv_engine_note.message: Extension settings → translation engine. You can also start on the free channel with no key.

ob_kv_capture_note.message: It is off by default. Once on, the sentences you stop and read become cards.

ob_read_body.message: You are set up — just browse and translate as usual. What you read accumulates; to keep a sentence right away, long-press its translation.

ob_kv_twice.message: You will sign in inside the extension too

ob_kv_twice_note.message: The two sides have separate storage, so you get two codes. Use the same email address.

ob_kv_engine_note_required.message: Extension settings → translation engine. This one is unavoidable: without a key nothing gets translated.

extob_welcome_title.message: Read and remember, without leaving the page

extob_welcome_body.message: The original stays where it is; the translation appears right below it. Sentences you actually stop and read become review cards that come back on a forgetting curve.

extob_engine_body_free.message: The free channel works with no setup. For better quality, add your own API key.

extob_engine_body_key.message: There is no way around this one: without a key, nothing gets translated.

extob_capture_title.message: Want it to remember what you read?

extob_capture_body.message: Off by default. Turn it on and the sentences you actually finish reading (not the ones you scroll past) become review cards.

extob_capture_toggle.message: Save sentences I read as review cards

extob_capture_note.message: Only sentences you actually finish reading. You can turn this off any time, and delete everything from a site at once.

extob_try_body.message: Open a real page and tap the floating button in the corner — the translation appears under each paragraph.

extob_sync_body.message: Everything works fully without an account — your data stays on this device. Sign in only if you want your phone to pick up where your computer left off.

extob_app_note.message: Want to review on your phone, or listen in podcast mode while walking? Those live in the iPhone and Mac app.

extob_done_text.message: Open any page in another language and tap the floating button. Settings and this walkthrough are both in the extension's settings page.

extob_unpacked_note.message: Installed from a ZIP: this copy does not update itself. Grab new versions from the website, or install from the store for automatic updates.

extob_first_run.message: First time? Two minutes to set it up →

qs_title.message: Set everything up with one key

qs_sub.message: On these platforms one key configures translation, read-aloud and transcription at once. Other engines are configured in their own cards below.

qs_privacy.message: Transcription sends your recording to {host}. It is discarded as soon as it is recognised — never stored, never synced.

qs_apply.message: Set up translation, read-aloud and transcription

qs_untouched.message: — left alone · you already configured this ({cur})

qs_tts_untried.message: (not played yet — use “Play a sample” in the Voice card below to hear it)

qs_stt_failed_note.message: Recording is not switched on by this. What was just sent was a 0.6-second sine tone, not your voice.

engine_test_empty_audio.message: The endpoint responded but returned no audio
